## Docs Change Checklist (DoR / DoD aligned)
This checklist is intended to mirror the intent of:
- `templates/governance/G.1_Definition_of_Ready.template.md`
- `templates/governance/G.2_Definition_of_Done.template.md`

### Ready (DoR)
- [ ] Objective is clearly stated and scope is explicit
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are testable (what changed and why)
- [ ] Dependencies / assumptions are documented (if any)
- [ ] Impacted systems/docs are identified (link to relevant A.1/A.4 if applicable)
- [ ] Risks / unknowns are noted (if any)
- [ ] Validation plan is included (at minimum: render + link sanity)

### Done (DoD)
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are met
- [ ] No broken internal links introduced; updated links where paths changed
- [ ] Documentation updates are consistent with SSOT and taxonomy
- [ ] No new docs were added outside the existing taxonomy
- [ ] Version header and change log updated (when applicable)
